name: scene-distillation-zine-v1-3
title_zh: 把一张照片蒸馏成一本情绪zine海报
tagline_zh: 照片不是拿来修的，是拿来拆的。只留你拍的线条和色块，配上高饱和撞色与手写大字，让一张旅行照变成能贴在墙上的宣言。
tagline_en: Stop editing photos—distill them. Keep only your lines and colors, add loud hues and hand-drawn type, and turn a.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied photo into an expressive minimal zine poster made only from original source-derived illustration, an artistic proposition, emotional tension, visual metaphor, spacious negative space, art-directed high-chroma color, and unconstrained authorial typography. Let wording, language, amount, placement, type voices, scale, direction, legibility, and image interaction follow expr
why_zh: 它不套滤镜、不叠模板，而是从原图里抽取几何与色彩关系，再按情绪张力重新编排版式——每次输出都是独一份的。
why_en: No filters, no templates—it mines your photo for geometry and color logic, then re-composes them as a visual argument. Every.
limit_zh: 只吃单张照片，且画面里得有可识别的轮廓或色块分层；纯渐变或全糊的图会产出空泛版面。文字排版由它全权决定。
limit_en: Single photo only; needs discernible shapes or color zones—pure gradients yield blank posters. Typography is fully auto-set: no font or placement.
